conflicts.description: One requires the successful command to match the unquoted `new change issue` while the other requires the literal quoted `new change "issue"`, and a second successful `new change` for the same change is impossible since it already exists.

verify_2 may only exist if the first verify reports a critical issue, yet these must-items unconditionally require verify_2 to be written (and archiving after it), so an honest run whose first verification finds no critical issues cannot satisfy both.
